name: Loot Wishes
summary: Keep a list of the items you hope to find and get a ping in chat the moment one drops, comes up for a roll or sits at a merchant.
logoPrompt: A small velvet drawstring pouch with a glowing golden star tied to its cord

cover.tagline: Your wanted items, never missed again.

description: **Loot Wishes keeps a list of the items you want and tells you as soon as one of them shows up in your loot or at a merchant.**
- A wish list of items, filled with a shift-click or an item ID.
- A chat line and a short sound when a wished item is in your loot window or up for a loot roll.
- Notes when you or another player near you receives a wished item.
- Names wished items a merchant sells as soon as you open the window.
- The item tooltip shows when an item is on your list.
Type `/lw add` and shift-click the item into the chat line, or type its item ID. `/lw list` shows the list, `/lw remove` takes an item off, `/lw sound off` keeps it quiet.
- An item counts in every difficulty and upgrade level.
- Inside instances the game can hide loot details from addons, so some hits may go unreported there.
- Shared by all characters of your account, up to 500 items.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
